args.message: SMOKE {{run}} reply with exactly the single word PONG and nothing else. Do not use any tools.

lookup.conv: SELECT id FROM agent_conversations WHERE title LIKE 'SMOKE {{run}}%' AND agent_member_id = 47 ORDER BY id DESC

lookup.run1: SELECT max(id) FROM agent_runs WHERE conversation_id = {{conv}}

shell: for i in $(seq 1 60); do s=$(sudo -n -u postgres psql -d maludb_os -Atc "SELECT status FROM agent_runs WHERE id = {{run1}}"); [ "$s" != running ] && break; sleep 3; done; echo $s

lookup.said: SELECT chat_utterance IS NOT NULL AND result ILIKE '%PONG%' FROM agent_runs WHERE id = {{run1}}

args.message: SMOKE {{run}} which single word did I ask you to say before? Answer with that word only. Do not use any tools.

lookup.run2: SELECT max(id) FROM agent_runs WHERE conversation_id = {{conv}}

shell: for i in $(seq 1 60); do s=$(sudo -n -u postgres psql -d maludb_os -Atc "SELECT status FROM agent_runs WHERE id = {{run2}}"); [ "$s" != running ] && break; sleep 3; done; echo $s

lookup.carried: SELECT instructions LIKE '%Earlier in this conversation%' AND instructions LIKE '%PONG%' FROM agent_runs WHERE id = {{run2}}

lookup.stamped: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_runs WHERE conversation_id = {{conv}} AND trigger = 'chat' AND requested_by = 1

args.message: SMOKE {{run}} a playbook agent cannot chat

lookup.renamed: SELECT title FROM agent_conversations WHERE id = {{conv}}

lookup.archived: SELECT archived_at IS NOT NULL FROM agent_conversations WHERE id = {{conv}}
